nodes.text: #HumanMetapneumovirus (#HMPV) is a virus that usually causes symptoms very similar to a cold. You might cough, or wheeze, have a runny nose, or a sore throat. Most cases are mild, but young children, adults over 65, and people with weakened immune systems are at a higher risk. https://t.co/YaIjyKBzpa
